title: Schedule Ii And Iii Maintenance Medications
subtopic: Schedule II and III maintenance medications
rule_summary: Current Massachusetts Board policy permits qualifying Schedule II and III maintenance medications to be included in multi-drug single-dose compliance packages; the change does not convert every acute Schedule II or III course into maintenance therapy or waive other packaging requirements.
exam_relevance: Tests a distinct pharmacist decision path using current official authority rather than rote trivia.
verification_notes: Authoring-session current official-source verification on 2026-08-14; requires fresh independent audit before release.
